bathAction.title: Clean nipples deeper
bathAction.tooltip: Rinse inside the nipples. Unavailable while they are plugged or sealed.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(pinch)] one of [npc.her] [npc.nipples] between wet fingers and [npc.verb(work)] warm water into it, then the other, rinsing out whatever had gathered inside. [npc.She] [npc.verb(keep)] the pressure light. [npc.speech(Inside the nipples too. They hold onto it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(roll)] [npc.her] [npc.nipples] under the hot water and [npc.verb(work)] it into them, slow, until the heat, and anything they were holding, comes back out. [npc.She] [npc.verb(let)] out [npc.a_moan+] and [npc.verb(do)] it again. [npc.speech(Sensitive. Keep going. I want them empty and warm.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(squeeze)] [npc.her] [npc.nipples] and [npc.verb(flush)] them out, one then the other, until nothing else comes. [npc.She] [npc.verb(hiss)] and [npc.verb(rinse)] them off. [npc.speech(Empty them. I am not leaving anything in there.)]
